text:
alex.k: FYI we're doing a controlled switchover of `zephyr-mini` tomorrow 08:30 PDT. Aim: validate perf on Dedicated with a safety-leash so we can abort fast.

maya: Plan sketch: region-by-region canary (us-west1 then eu-west1) -> 10m @ 3% traffic, observability baseline check, then 30m @ 10%, then 2-step to 40% before full. Keep circuit-breaker enabled.

nina: +1. Circuit-breaker settings: trip if p95 > baseline +25ms for 5m OR error-rate > 0.8% for 3m. If tripped, rollback to `zephyr-stable` automatically.

liam: For fallbacks, recommend strict ordered list: [zephyr-alt-quant, legacy-slim, degenerator-v1]. No randomization. We want predictable latency tails.

jen: I'll put the change window in the release notes: 08:30-10:30 PDT, owners: rollout = @maya, rollback = @sam. Customer-impact tag: low. I'll also add a line about KV priming and cost bump during warmup.

sam: Confirmed I own manual rollback/pin. Runbook: `platformctl pin --model=zephyr-stable --scope=global` then revoke weights. If autopin suggested, I'll ACK within 3 minutes. Also will notify #customer-uptime + account owners.

deploybot: deploybot: preflight passed except minor warning on telemetry delay (ETA 2m). Suggest autopin thresholds: p95 >= +18% OR token OOM errors >= 1 in 5m. Autopin will only propose, not execute unless operator ack.

opsbot: opsbot: priming command (run during 10m warmup):
```sh
POST https://internal-cache/prime
Headers: Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN
Body: {"model":"zephyr-mini","prompt_set":"stability-suite","count":25}
```
This reduces first-token variance and KV cold misses.

alex.k: One extra safety: temporary TTL reduction on cache to 20s for first 40m so we can see steady-state behavior quickly; revert after successful 40m window.

maya: QA scheduled 07:50-08:10 to run crash cases and perf harness. Will paste results here.

jen: Note for sales/success: I'll draft the short customer message in #customer-uptime and schedule to send only if we flip fully.

sam: If we need a partial pinch (regional only), use `platformctl pin --model=zephyr-stable --scope=region --region=eu-west1`. Keep communication tight.

deploybot: At go-time use `/deploy start --model=zephyr-mini --mode=canary --regions=us-west1,eu-west1 --safety-leash=on`

alex.k: Approved. If nobody objects to fallback ordering or thresholds in 30m we proceed. :thumbsup:
